exposure: older infant age at time of operation
outcome: extended need for hospital care during the first year of life
cohort: The study included all live-born infants with simple d-TGA (TGA ± small ventricular septal defect, n = 127) born in Finland during 2004-2014.
finding: Infants with d-TGA born with lower gestational age and to older mothers had increased mortality, though all prenatally diagnosed d-TGA infants survived.
